excerpt.zh: 来自[diplomatic_support_issuer.GetName]的代表团已经抵达目的地。他们的外交访问现在可以正式开始了，我们祝愿他们的和平事业取得成功。
excerpt.en: The delegates from the [diplomatic_support_issuer.GetName] have arrived at their destination. Their diplomatic visit can now officially begin, and we wish them success in their peaceful endeavors.
